desc: My day job for four years. I built pages and features for the company's B2B e-commerce site and its warehouse management system, and owned much of the MySQL underneath: a 1,000+ table schema, replication, and the queries and reports that internal teams and B2B clients ran.

A Spring Boot REST API that checks contact-form submissions (name length, email format, message size) and forwards the valid ones to my phone as Telegram messages. It ran this site's contact form while it was hosted on Heroku.
A searchable product list with prices and UPCs for a local supermarket, built as the first step toward a full inventory system. Customers waited about 20% less for price checks.
Tracks which games in a large collection work and which don't, and picks out the highly rated ones.
A personal project and a gift. I fitted an Arcade1Up cabinet with a Raspberry Pi running RetroPie, so it plays a full game library instead of the few games it shipped with.

The site you're reading. I first built it in 2022 on Create React App and Semantic UI, then rebuilt it in 2026 on Vite with hand-written CSS. The contact form now runs through a small Netlify Function that can deliver to Telegram or Slack.
